title: Wallace's closing remarks on Rosetta Reitz's visit
summary: Wallace thanks Reitz for the visit, praises Little Brother and her pianist Dave, and says she keeps writing blues.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: The day that Rosetta come here, she come here the day after the power was restored back to my home. This is Sippie Wallace talking and Lord, the storm had everybody's heat cut off and lights cut off and everybody, everybody, was stranded for heat and cold. Lord was good, got the heat come back and Rosetta was able to come in and Saturday, 12:00, and interviewed me and we had a lovely interview and had made a lovely tape. And we had a -- we came back church and seen a beautiful musical and came back to my home and did some more interviewing and she have had a wonderful time here. I've enjoyed her immensely. I heard some records I ain't heard since I was 15 years old. (Unintelligible) going to give you credit. Girl, I sure have enjoyed myself. I have enjoyed myself to the height.

I never will forget that good music that me and Little Brother -- I'm telling you true, girl, I sure did enjoy that that Hocile singing. It sounds just like it was yesterday. It sounds just like it was only yesterday that all this good stuff was going on and I never will forget it. It was wonderful. And I hope you enjoyed yourself, too.
Oh, I did. I loved hearing the music with you. I enjoyed that very much.
It was so beautiful. I'm so glad you enjoyed it.
And I thank you for playing for me.
I thank you. I'm so glad.
I'm so glad, I'm so glad.
And I loved hearing you in church today.
I'm so glad and my pastor will never forget you. He enjoyed you ______ to the height. I'll tell you, anytime you want me in New York, just let me know.

And tell me about Little Brother, so I can get him word, so he can come with me because he is my piano player. Then I got another piano player, Dave. He is almost as good -- he plays just about as good as Little Brother. Of course, I'd rather have Little Brother, because he's more familiar. But Dave is just as good. If I can't get Little Brother, Dave is all right.
